answer: Trust flows from 20 audited seed accounts through 4 random-walk rounds along vouch edges, and an account needs a score above 0.02 to earn. Fake identities form a sparse trellis attached to the honest meadow by few edges, so walks rarely cross; each extra sybil dilutes the cluster's score, while buying real vouches costs a locked 6 POA stake per edge. Validators recompute the walk from the public ledger, and marble-clear transparency lets anyone challenge a score.
